note: No Instagram account connected. Trends are what is currently popular in these three domains, not a platform-wide census.
source: public Instagram trend discovery (social.search, platform=instagram, ranked by engagement)

trends.details: A 31K-like House of CB reel models a long, form-fitting red velvet gown with a lace corset bodice and long sleeves, the ruched velvet skirt sweeping to the floor in front of a lit tree with red ribbons, wrapped pink gifts, and an ornate fireplace. A 13K-like reel runs five holiday cocktail dresses — a burgundy sleeveless dress with a flowing cape back and open back, a lime-green two-piece set with floral embroidery and bell sleeves, a black sleeveless mini with pearl and floral embellishments and an open back, a burgundy dress with a draped cowl neckline and short sleeves, and an olive-green sleeveless satin mini. A 10K-like reel presents 'BURGUNDY CHRISTMAS OUTFIT INSPO' — a burgundy sequin peplum top and matching sequin bag with a long burgundy satin maxi skirt, pointed-toe burgundy heels with gold tips, gold hoop earrings, and multiple gold bangles. A 7.5K-like Zara holiday party haul runs five all-black looks — a black long-sleeve turtleneck with black-and-gold sequin shorts, sheer tights, and a black fuzzy clutch; a black velvet short-sleeve playsuit with shoulder pads; a black one-shoulder mini dress with rhinestone detailing and a beaded bag; a strapless navy-blue sequin jumpsuit; and a black turtleneck with black velvet wide-leg pants. A 6.3K-like Zara try-on pairs a white lace bralette with high-waisted burgundy velvet wide-leg pants and a matching burgundy velvet blazer with fluffy fur cuffs, finished with two layered gold necklaces. A 5.5K-like Zara fitting-room trip, filmed by a size 10–12 creator, tries on about ten looks — a black velvet floral jumpsuit with sequin details, a silver sequin pencil skirt with a cream cowl-neck sweater, a dark green velvet slip dress with nude lace trim, a bronze sequin maxi dress, and a red velvet halter maxi with a plunging neckline.
trends.title: Burgundy velvet takes party season — House of CB lace corsets, Zara hauls, and sequin everything

trends.details: A 40K-like Joanna Gaines reel opens on a large fully decorated tree, unlit, near tall windows in a room with dark wood paneling, checkered tile flooring, and a green velvet armchair — then its warm white lights switch on, flooding the space with a golden glow. A 38K-like tutorial, Day 13 of a '25 days of Christmas craft series,' folds shiny green metallic paper into little Christmas trees topped with red glitter stars, strings them on pink cord, and hangs the garland across a white fireplace mantel. A 30K-like 'DIY my living room with me' transforms a dated room — patterned wallpaper, a black sectional, heavy curtains — into light cream walls with a light beige modular sectional, a lit tree with red ribbons and baubles, a nutcracker, and garland on the mantel. A 23K-like 'POV: A Frank Sinatra Christmas' tour moves through rooms in classic red, green, and gold — a tree with red velvet bows and gold and red ornaments, a kitchen counter with a 'French Recipes' cookbook and a snowflake mug, a stone fireplace with a fire burning, and a hand holding Frank Sinatra's 'Ultimate Christmas' vinyl. A 23K-like tour of a maximalist New York City apartment shows a tree covered in multicolored vintage-style ornaments with a red-and-white gingham tree skirt, garlands with fairy lights over doorways and windows, a bedroom with a brick wall and Christmas-tree bedding, and a kitchen with a large red gingham bow and 'MERRY CHRISTMAS' lettering. An 18K-like tutorial makes the viral book page garland — individual book pages stapled into teardrop-shaped leaflets, strung together and draped across a cabinet and from the ceiling with paper snowflakes and fairy lights. A 16K-like reel presents 'How to have a 1990's Christmas aesthetic' — a nutcracker microphone, a Santa figurine reading a book, 'Fa La La La' tea towels, a ceramic Christmas tree, a Peanuts Snoopy train set, and a lit-up Christmas village.
trends.title: The tree lights switch on — Joanna Gaines glow, paper-tree garlands, and a 1990s Christmas

trends.details: A 73K-like before-and-after reel goes from a messy bun, satin robe, and small black star stickers on the chin to long styled hair, full makeup with blush and lipstick, and a red top. A 63K-like Victoria Beckham tutorial, filmed by a lit fireplace, builds a 'Fireside Glow' — 'Signature Sculpt' contour drawn with the Contour Stylus in Marble, Colour Wash Blush Water Tint in Flushed high on the cheekbones, and the Reflect Highlighter Stick in Pearl on the cheekbones, brow bone, and lips, buffed to a soft-focus finish, followed by a gifting segment for her Hotel Portofino fragrance. A 54K-like carousel covers Jennifer Lawrence's look for The Hunger Games: Sunrise On The Reaping NY premiere — a black outfit with a white fur collar and statement earrings, Dior lipsticks and blush, and shimmery eyeshadow applied from a Dior quad palette. A 39K-like tutorial demos 'holiday makeup for hooded eyes' — red-pink shadow blended above the crease with a cotton pad as a shield for a lifted winged effect, a shimmery pink lid, and mascara. An 11K-like reel opens the Mecca Max 'Midnight Countdown' 12-piece beauty advent calendar — a red hexagonal box — and applies a full face from the minis inside, landing on a pink-purple smoky eye. A 9.6K-like 'ICY Winter Glam' look pairs dramatic silver-white eyeshadow and sharp black winged liner with pink blush, glossy nude-pink lips, and glitter on the collarbones, worn with a white fluffy hooded coat. An 8.2K-like snowflake-inspired tutorial starts with shimmery eyeshadow, then hand-draws delicate snowflakes with a white liquid liner pen on the outer corners of the eyes, extending onto the cheeks, with small white dots and star accents.
trends.title: Before-and-after glam and fireside glow — Victoria Beckham's sculpt, icy silver, and snowflake eyes
